title: Brighouse Autonomy Security Lab: mavaudit, MAVLink signing measurements, and acceptance-semantics model
description: Defensive security research artifact for MAVLink-based drones and autonomous systems, aligned to the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA). Includes: mavaudit (a key-less MAVLink configuration auditor with CRA-mapped findings), a parameterised acceptance-semantics formal model with bounded adversary exploration and design-space synthesis, a model-based conformance harness, a reproducible secure-by-default score, and measured software-in-the-loop results for ArduPilot 4.7.2 and PX4 v1.17.0 / v1.18.0-rc1. Simulation-only; contains no exploit code or attack automation.
